name: gpu-campaign
description: The GPU work that has been waiting for a real GPU, most important first, with the most expensive job (ResNet-18) last. Run with: python -m fabricpc.bench queue fabricpc/bench/plans/gpu_campaign.json --out ~/runs/gpu-campaign. Ids not in the registry yet are skipped with a message. The deeper VGGs (VGG-7/9) are in gpu_deep_vgg.json instead, because their layouts still need the sponsor's sign-off.
